command:
cat > /usr/local/sbin/appdata-loop-setup <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
IMAGE=/var/lib/appdata-lvm.img
LOOPDEV=$(losetup -j "$IMAGE" | sed -n '1s/:.*//p')
if [ -z "$LOOPDEV" ]; then
  LOOPDEV=$(losetup --find --show "$IMAGE")
fi
lvmdevices --adddev "$LOOPDEV" >/dev/null
pvscan --cache "$LOOPDEV" >/dev/null
vgchange -ay appvg >/dev/null
printf '%s\n' "$LOOPDEV" > /run/appdata-loop.device
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/appdata-loop-setup
cat > /etc/systemd/system/appdata-loop.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Attach file-backed LVM storage for application data
DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-udevd.service
Before=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/appdata-loop-setup

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs-pre.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
UUID=$(blkid -s UUID -o value /dev/appvg/data)
printf 'UUID=%s /srv/data xfs defaults,x-systemd.requires=appdata-loop.service,x-systemd.after=appdata-loop.service,x-systemd.device-timeout=30 0 0\n' "$UUID" >> /etc/fstab
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable appdata-loop.service
mount -a
systemctl is-enabled appdata-loop.service
findmnt /srv/data
awk '$2=="/srv/data" {print}' /etc/fstab

command:
set -eu
mkdir -p /srv/data/config /srv/data/records /var/lib/appdata-snapshots
printf '%s\n' 'mode=production' 'schema=3' > /srv/data/config/app.conf
printf '%s\n' '{"id":1,"state":"ready"}' '{"id":2,"state":"queued"}' > /srv/data/records/events.jsonl
printf '%s\n' 'snapshot rollback payload' > /srv/data/payload.txt
ln -s ../payload.txt /srv/data/config/payload-link
chmod 640 /srv/data/config/app.conf
chmod 600 /srv/data/records/events.jsonl
sync
find /srv/data -xdev -mindepth 1 -printf '%P|%y|%m|%u|%g|%s|%T@|%l\n' | sort > /var/lib/appdata-snapshots/prechange.metadata
find /srv/data -xdev -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > /var/lib/appdata-snapshots/prechange.sha256
xfs_freeze -f /srv/data
if lvcreate --snapshot --size 512M --name data_prechange /dev/appvg/data; then
  xfs_freeze -u /srv/data
else
  rc=$?
  xfs_freeze -u /srv/data
  exit "$rc"
fi
lvs -o vg_name,lv_name,lv_attr,origin,lv_size,data_percent
printf '%s\n' '--- captured metadata ---'
cat /var/lib/appdata-snapshots/prechange.metadata
printf '%s\n' '--- captured hashes ---'
cat /var/lib/appdata-snapshots/prechange.sha256

set -eu
